rows.quote_or_number: It doesn't provide the "Suggest Edits" feature for blog posts, only answers to questions. Until I discovered Quora, I was working on http://wikiblog.jugglethis.net/ which was my solution to this problem.
rows.note: Writer wanted suggest-edits feature for blog posts; built alternative solution (wikiblog)

rows.quote_or_number: I've never seen Stack Exchange used as a blogpost medium and I like it! It's still formatted as Q&A so people with the same question can find it, and what's more, suggest edits or write alternative solutions on equal footing themselves.
rows.note: Praising Stack Exchange for enabling collaborative editing/solutions on equal footing as medium for technical posts

rows.quote_or_number: I write pretty long blog posts that some enjoy and dump them into various llms for review. I am pretty opinionated on taste so I usually only update grammar but it can be dangerous for some.
rows.note: Solo author writing long blog posts, using LLMs for review/suggestions but selective about accepting changes

rows.quote_or_number: Anybody can suggest edits without even registering.
rows.note: Stack Overflow feature allowing community suggested edits to posts

rows.quote_or_number: If this was a wiki or something I could try to fix those issues, but as it currently is I don't see any way to even flag it.
rows.note: Reader cannot suggest corrections or flag errors in recipe content; desires wiki-style editing

rows.quote_or_number: if English is not your primary language, it shouldn't be difficult to get someone you know to help you proofread and edit your work.
rows.note: Commenter suggesting blog authors need help with proofreading/editing to improve quality and readership
